subject: Next Steps — Buyer Roles, Security RFI, and Target Latency Envelope
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@medlinehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@medlinehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Next Steps — Buyer Roles, Security RFI, and Target Latency Envelope

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from our call
- Primary use case: real-time assist for triage workflows (avg request size ~350 tokens; peak concurrent sessions ~35–50).
- Desired p95 per-token latency: <= 120ms in prod; goal to test at 150ms to validate realism.
- Hosting preference: Dedicated or Private VPC (you flagged data residency + PHI concerns).
- Must clear security questionnaire (RFI) and provide SOC-2 evidence; procurement expects an MSA.

Agreed next steps
1) Sophie: share security contact + procurement timeline (you mentioned a 4–6 week window for procurement review).
2) Tom: confirm the econ buyer (you said likely the VP of Ops) and expected budgetary cadence.
3) Redwood (me + Laura): share a short SLA parameters spreadsheet and a draft MSA so your legal can start parallel review.

Please confirm the two names we should include on the RFI distribution and any blackout weeks for your team next two weeks.

I'll attach the SLA worksheet and a redlined MSA template for visibility.

Thanks — looking forward to the next check-in.

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-msas-draft.pdf (PDF)
- sla-parameters.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@medlinehealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next Steps — Buyer Roles, Security RFI, and Target Latency Envelope

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear notes. Quick answers: 

- Security contact: Elena Rodriguez (elena.rodriguez@medlinehealth.com). She owns vendor security reviews and will own the RFI intake.
- Procurement: Aaron Patel (aaron.patel@medlinehealth.com) will be the procurement lead. He typically runs an initial review and then loops legal.
- Econ buyer: yes, confirmed — Claire Donovan (VP, Clinical Ops) is our economic decision-maker; she'll want a simple TCO number plus expected per-session p95.
- Timeline: internal procurement + security review is ~3–5 weeks if nothing blocks; legal may add another 1–2 weeks for MSA redlines.

One ask: does Redwood have a short statement on where inference logs are stored and retention options? We must include that in the RFI.

On availability — Elena and Aaron are available for a 30-min RFI kickoff on Wed 7/22 or Thu 7/23 between 13:00–16:00 ET.

Thanks,
Sophie

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:07:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next Steps — Buyer Roles, Security RFI, and Target Latency Envelope

Hi all —

Thanks Sophie — that's perfect. Quick answers inline and a couple asks for the Redwood team: 

- Logs & retention: by default, inference logs (request/response metadata) are retained for 90 days in encrypted object storage; customers can configure retention down to 0 days or up to indefinite retention on Dedicated/Private (we'll document options in the RFI). PHI payloads should be routed to Private deployments per our security guidance.

- RFI kickoff: Wed 7/22 at 14:00 ET works for us. We'll invite Elena and Aaron.

Ben / Laura (cc'd): can you 1) prepare a one-page TCO sketch showing expected unit cost at 10k monthly sessions and 100k monthly sessions, and 2) populate the SLA sheet with a P95 baseline (current hosted: 140ms avg p95 for similar models; Dedicated tuning can get to ~110–120ms depending on batch and KV cache) — I'll add our recommended hosting notes in the SLA file.

I attached a lightweight MSA draft for legal to start; it's non-final but should shorten cycles. I'll also share a short technical diagram showing VPC options.

Next internal step: Ben — can you have the TCO sketch ready by EOD Wednesday so we can include it in the RFI packet? Laura — please add the p95 notes and retention options to the SLA worksheet before the kickoff.

Thanks —
Marcus

Attachments:
- sla-parameters.xlsx (XLSX)
- redwood-tech-arch.png (PNG)
- redwood-msas-draft.pdf (PDF)

Ben / Laura —

Internal note — copying the external thread above for context. Action items (short):

2) Laura: Fill SLA sheet with p95 baseline and known tuning range; include hosting guidance for PHI (Private/VPC) and retention options.
3) I'll join the RFI kickoff on 7/22 to support technical questions.
